summary: Iteration 7 (singer-first artist attribution, new professional /api/search, multi-artist ⋯ sheet, queue Upnext/Lyrics/Related tabs, shared LyricsView with gap dots, gesture-handler equalizer faders) FULLY VERIFIED. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest passed (test_iteration7.py). GET /api/search?q=kesariya → 200 with query/top/artists/artistSongs/songs. songs[0].title='Kesariya (From "Brahmastra")', artist starts with 'Arijit Singh', artistHandle='459320', artists[]=[{Arijit Singh},{Pritam},...] (Arijit before Pritam). No Lofi/Remix/Slowed/Mashup titles in songs[]. Titles deduplicated by normalized-title+duration. GET /api/search?q=kesariya lofi → songs[] contains lofi variants (variant filter suppressed only when query has no variant words). GET /api/search?q=arijit singh → top.type='artist', top.title='Arijit Singh', artistSongs len=15 (≥5), songs[] has no ids overlapping with artistSongs. GET /api/search (missing q) → 422. GET /api/tracks/trending?limit=5 → every track has artists[] list and artistHandle (string or null). GET /api/tracks/search?q=kesariya → tracks[0].artist starts with 'Arijit Singh'. Regression: /api/tracks/{id}/recommendations 200 (list), /api/search/suggest?q=arij 200 with 'Arijit' in blob, /api/lyrics for Hindi trending 200 with synced/plain/instrumental/source keys, /api/jam POST→GET→DELETE lifecycle 200/200/200 (code matches [A-Z0-9]{6}), GET after DELETE → 404. FRONTEND (390x844 web): Search 'arijit singh' → Top result testID top-result-459320 with 'Arijit Singh · 106,599,413 followers' subtitle, 'Top songs · Arijit Singh' header (1 hit), 'More songs' header (1 hit); tapping top-result opens artist page (header text 'Arijit Singh', 106.6M followers, 10 tracks, Top tracks list). Search 'kesariya' → first row 'Kesariya (From "Brahmastra")' by 'Arijit Singh, Pritam' (Arijit first). No 'lofi/remix/slowed/mashup' in first-viewport results. Kesariya ⋯ sheet opens with 'View Arijit Singh' (testID action-view-artist), 'View Pritam' and 'View Amitabh Bhattacharya' (both testID action-view-artist-<id>). Tapping action-view-artist navigates to Arijit Singh artist page. Player artist link (testID player-artist-link) tapped on multi-credited Kesariya → chooser modal opens (track-actions-modal) with same 3 View rows — no crash. Queue: player-queue-btn opens queue-screen with queue-tabs and queue-tab-upnext / queue-tab-lyrics / queue-tab-related. Up next tab shows 'Now Playing' + 'Next in queue · 22' with 8 queue rows; NO 'Similar songs' list (only the tab label 'Related' at top). Related tab: Autoplay card + 'RELATED TO "Ram Siya Ram"' header + 15× suggest-play-<id> and 15× suggest-add-<id> rows. Lyrics tab: lyrics-view renders (no crash). Lyrics screen (player-lyrics-btn) opens lyrics-screen with lyrics-view; lyrics-close returns. Equalizer /equalizer: equalizer-screen present with 10 fader boxes (each 40×150). Starting gains all 0. Mouse drag first fader up 50px → +8.5 dB (0.5 dB step); page scrollY unchanged (0→0, drag did NOT scroll page). Drag downward → -3.5. Tap on top of track → +11. Bass Boost preset (preset-Bass Boost) sets faders to +7/+6/+5/+3/+1/0/0/0/0. Thumb follows finger, no stuck-drag observed. Flat preset zeros faders back. No red console errors (only pre-existing audio-source and Chromium autoplay warnings, which are filtered out).

integration_issues.issue: Chromium HTMLAudio still can't decode JioSaavn AAC-in-mp4 in web preview; not blocking on native.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py normalize_song (line 91-148): singer-first ordering is solid. The final artist string joins first 2 ordered[] names, so display shows 'Arijit Singh, Pritam' for Kesariya; artists[] carries up to 4 with roles. artistHandle is the id of the first ordered artist that has one — matches Arijit Singh (459320) as expected.

server.py /search (line 218-270): variant filter via _is_variant + _variant_key, per-key best-of-playcount dedupe, exact-key ranking, and artistSongs exclusion from songs[] all working. wants_variant correctly enables lofi/remix when the query contains those words. Minor: on line 247 the boolean grouping `top and top['title'].lower() in q_clean.lower() or top and q_clean.lower() in top['title'].lower()` is fine due to Python precedence but reads ambiguously — consider parens.

track-actions.tsx (line 228-247): ⋯ sheet builds View <artist> rows from track.artists filtered by id, falling back to a single row from artistHandle. testID logic: first row = action-view-artist, subsequent = action-view-artist-<id> — matches spec exactly. Trailing 'Composer' label is only rendered when a.role === 'music' (line 241). Observation: because normalize_song pushes primary_artists with role='primary' before reaching the role='music' branch, composers who are ALSO in primary_artists (e.g. Pritam on 'Kesariya') get role='primary', so the 'Composer' trailing label never rendered in the tested song. The review note 'trailing label Composer may be present' treats this as optional, so it's not blocking, but if you want the label to actually appear for composers, tag them as 'music' in normalize_song when their JioSaavn role is 'music', regardless of their presence in primary_artists.

equalizer.tsx Fader (line 234-315): rewrite with Gesture.Pan + Gesture.Tap via Exclusive() with activeOffsetY([-2,2]) and failOffsetX([-30,30]) — correctly captures vertical drags without triggering the ScrollView. useSharedValue for live/start/dragging with a stepped emit on 0.5 dB boundaries. Verified: page did not scroll during a 50px vertical drag, no stuck thumbs across multiple consecutive drags, tap-to-set works, presets still overwrite faders.

queue.tsx (313 lines): tabs implemented with local state, lyrics tab reuses shared LyricsView (embedded), Up next section is cleanly separated from Related section (no leaked 'Similar songs' list). Suggestions still seeded from the current song via useAudio, matching the 'stays stable' requirement.

lyrics-view.tsx (313 lines): shared between /lyrics screen and queue Lyrics tab via embedded prop. Gap dots row rendered at intro/instrumental gaps with testID lyrics-gap-active (active-only) — on web the audio doesn't advance so the active-state variant won't fire, but the dot row itself is rendered.
search.tsx (438 lines) — approaching the 700-line soft cap but still fine; consider splitting the results rendering out if it grows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested surface (search top-result + tap-to-artist, kesariya singer-first attribution + no variants, ⋯ multi-artist rows, player-artist-link chooser, queue tabs upnext/lyrics/related with 15 suggestions and no 'Similar songs' leak, lyrics-screen + embedded lyrics-view in queue, equalizer drag up/down/tap + preset + no-scroll)

seed_data_creation: None persistent. test_jam_lifecycle creates one jam room and deletes it in the same test; no leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-7 testIDs (new/changed): top-result-<id> (artist top result card on search), action-view-artist (first ⋯ row) + action-view-artist-<id> (additional composer/lyricist rows), player-artist-link (tap opens chooser when >1 credited artist), queue-tabs / queue-tab-upnext / queue-tab-lyrics / queue-tab-related, suggest-play-<id> / suggest-add-<id> / suggest-more-<id> inside Related tab, lyrics-view (shared, embedded flag in queue), lyrics-gap-active (only while actively playing an intro gap — won't fire on web where audio is silent), preset-<Name> (e.g. preset-Bass Boost). Fader is drag/tap only — no dedicated testID on the box, use CSS bounding-rect selection for 40x150 within [data-testid='equalizer-screen']. To reach Sound tab on web, navigate directly to /equalizer (not /sound). Web audio decode still fails on JioSaavn AAC-in-mp4 (pre-existing) — this does not affect UI/queue/lyrics testing but means the lyrics-gap-active state can't be reproduced on web.
rca_of_issue: The user-reported bugs from iteration 7 are all fixed and verified: (1) 'Kesariya credited to Pritam' → normalize_song now puts singers first via a multi-pass push (line 111-124 in server.py) and joins the first two ordered names, giving 'Arijit Singh, Pritam' with artistHandle=459320. (2) 'Search should be professional' → new GET /api/search returns a top artist card, that artist's real topSongs from artist.getArtistPageDetails, and de-duplicated songs with variant filtering (_is_variant/_variant_key) unless the query itself asks for lofi/remix/etc. (3) '⋯ shows only one artist' → track-actions.tsx line 228-247 now iterates track.artists (up to 3 with ids) and renders 'View <name>' per credited artist. (4) 'Queue lacks tabs' → queue.tsx now has queue-tabs with Up next / Lyrics / Related; Related is seeded from the current song via useAudio suggestions and stays stable. (5) 'Faders getting stuck' → Fader was rewritten with react-native-gesture-handler Gesture.Pan + Gesture.Tap via Exclusive, using shared values on the UI thread; verified stable across up/down/tap sequences with no stuck thumb and no page scroll during drag.
